description: This file defines the CategoryDao interface, which declares data access methods for Category entities within a shopping application's catalog system. It includes methods for retrieving categories by various attributes such as URL, store, lineage, name, code, depth, parent, and language, as well as counting products by categories.

classes.name: CategoryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for Category entities, extending generic DAO for CRUD operations and declaring specific queries related to category retrieval and counting.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories associated with the specified merchant store and SEO URL.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Retrieves categories for a merchant store filtered by a parent category.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Retrieves categories for a merchant store based on an ancestral lineage string.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves categories by name within a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a category by its unique code within a merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves all categories associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves categories for a store filtered by language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its unique identifier.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories for a store at a specified depth level.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories for a store at a specified depth level, filtered by language.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Retrieves categories in a store based on a lineage code.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by store code and category code.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetches a category by store and SEO URL.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories with a specific parent category filtered by language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a category associated with a specific language by category ID.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Counts the number of products associated with each category ID in the provided list within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves categories by a list of codes within a store and filtered by language.

methods.name: getByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories by a list of IDs within a store, filtered by language.
